title: Hiring Plan: Hire Fast vs. Stay Lean
description: Aggressively staff up ahead of demand, or keep the team small until product-market fit?

decision.prompt: Choose your hiring velocity for the next 12 months.

options.label: Hire 1 per quarter
options.description: Slow and deliberate — each hire is a high-conviction decision. Lower burn, slower capacity growth.

options.label: Hire 2 per quarter
options.description: Moderate pace — builds capability without overstretching the runway or culture.

options.label: Hire aggressively (4+ per quarter)
options.description: Scale ahead of demand. High burn and management overhead, but positions you to capture market fast.

current_headcount.label: Current Headcount
current_headcount.description: Total number of full-time employees today.

revenue_per_employee.label: Revenue per Employee ($)
revenue_per_employee.description: Target annual revenue generated per employee at steady state.

churn_risk_per_hire.label: Churn Risk per Hire
churn_risk_per_hire.description: Probability that a given new hire leaves within 12 months (as a decimal, e.g. 0.08 = 8%).
